stemMarkdown: 24 workers, each working 12 hours a day, can complete a job in 20 days. How many days will 22 workers, each working 7 hours a day, take to complete the same job? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total work $= 24 \times 20 \times 12$ worker-hours $= 5760$. With 22 workers at 7 hours/day, days needed $= \dfrac{5760}{22\times7} = 37.40$.
